versions.changelog:
- Initial release of runware-prompting.
- Provides guidance for writing effective prompts tailored to specific Runware image and video model families.
- Covers cross-family principles, including scene layering, prompt length, in-image text handling, and negation.
- Details prompting strategies for LLM-based, diffusion-based, and structured-input models.
- Outlines video prompting techniques focused on cinematic grammar, shot direction, and beat templates.
- Lists related skills for model selection and prompt execution.
